safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the blocked-ear/ear-symptom component slightly reduces completeness of the URI symptom picture but is unlikely to change diagnosis or immediate management in this context. The main risks are minor documentation inaccuracy and reduced continuity for follow-up.
